study.question: Does explicitly presenting per-field/action comparison support improve learning of latest-match temporal rank beyond a redundant-feature control, and does any effect depend on the zero chosen by rank encoding?
study.hypothesis: Source-level limitation: r0013-required_rank/r0014-latest_rank provide r=g*conditional_midrank, so r=0 aliases unsupported comparisons (g=0) with supported comparisons where every nonmatch is older (g=1, conditional_midrank=0). The diagnostic first512 impressions have support on 0.15576171875 of field/action coordinates; the prevalence of supported exact-zero ranks has NOT been measured. An explicit gate paired with rank may ease learning conditional evidence from sparse histories, using a summary computed from already available event populations, without adding raw information. The parent computes field-valid support counts internally but does not expose all of them to its classifier; exact recovery of g from existing classifier coordinates is NOT assumed when event fields are missing. Centering r to r-0.5*g moves the collision from supported zero to supported midrank0.5. This is a representation/optimization hypothesis, not a new information or causal-preference claim. Latest/all evidence is preliminary seed42: latest rank AUC0.6198327315 versus all rank0.6197123094, whereas all rank has better Logloss0.1958428330 versus0.1959002720. Respect primary AUC without concealing the secondary tradeoff.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit field-adapted local activation and embeddings. Primary DIN abandons softmax normalization; local ancestors retain normalized retrieval plus explicit counts/extrema. This study only exposes comparison support next to deterministic rank, and is not an exact DIN reproduction. Standard missingness indicators and centering are not claimed novel; nearest-source search for missing/support returned no further available primary text, which is not proof of priority.

Author README verifies category/brand/action histories without item identity. Publisher paper remains inaccessible; detailed full-DMR difference is unresolved. No item transitions or unavailable supervision introduced.

Exact hash-verified parent. Preserve its preceding features and raw rank computation, append8 columns for explicit gate versus duplicate encoded rank, and factor raw/centered encoding. Existing r0013-required_presence REPLACED rank, whereas here support accompanies rank; its lower AUC does not answer conjunction utility.

Available standalone ancestor sources and receipts distinguish latest versus all-anchor aggregation. Do not pursue all-anchor replacement after its lower primary AUC; preserve latest anchor. Exact seed42 parent reproduction is not independent repeated support.

inherited_components: All parent embedding/action/recency tables and shared normalized retrieval; fixed blind static context query
First40 scalar count, one-day-decayed match/support, latest match and latest nonmatch features
Required gate: receiving-field known-target nonmatches and opposite-field same-action known-target match; ties contribute0.5; raw ages, no sequence-order assumption
Original eight crossed conditional-rank features, final MLP layers and RNG order; only deterministic encoding and auxiliary coordinates vary
Baseline ladder AUC static0.6050036145, pooled0.6102261137, adaptedDIN0.6133619861; incumbent0.6198327315 on same validation population, no significance claimed
study.proposed_difference: Full 2x2 factorial: main rank q=r (raw) or q=r-0.5*g (centered); auxiliary a=0.5*g (explicit support) or a=0.5*q (duplicate). Classifier gets parent preceding features plus q plus a. Eight zero-initialized first-layer input columns are appended AFTER all parent modules are constructed, with no RNG draw. Four cells have identical parameter count and original initialization. In support cells raw/centered representations span exactly the same linear function class: q_centered=q_raw-a; differing fitted results diagnose optimization, not added information. Duplicate cells add no information beyond their chosen q, but do alter optimization parameterization. No learned gates, depth, token, optimizer/loss or history changes.
predictions: Before outcome interpretation, host diagnostics must show zero support/feature on empty histories or missing target fields; bounds, duplicate identity, centered reconstruction and cross-encoding affine equivalence errors should be near machine precision. Report supported-zero and supported-midrank counts/fractions separately from absent support. First512 diagnostics are descriptive, not population estimates.

Primary paired contrasts raw_support versus raw_duplicate and centered_support versus centered_duplicate test explicit support at matched dimensions/RNG/data passes. Consistent positive AUC contrasts with measured cost and nontrivial gate use would provisionally support exposing support. If valid-zero collisions dominate, expect larger utility in raw encoding; this is unverified until diagnostic counts are available.

The support-cell raw/centered contrast has identical first-layer function class. An isolated win in only one encoding suggests conditioning/optimization sensitivity, not robust support identification. Compare Logloss, parameter count, allocated/wall time, memory and whole-batch throughput/p50/p95; no equal-compute superiority inferred from matched passes.

Exploratory frozen host slices: empty, history1-16,17-64,>64; hour, behavior presence, frequency, missing/unseen fields as exposed. Retain host sample/positive/negative counts. Sparse first512 action cells including brand-buy support0 in prior diagnostics cannot support per-action effect claims. No labels are accessed by diagnostics.
falsifiers: No AUC improvement of support over its duplicate control in either encoding gives no support for this implementation; do not treat it as disproof of all support-aware methods.
If supported-zero/midrank counts are negligible, the proposed collision explanation lacks local empirical relevance; any improvement needs another explanation such as a shortcut to inherited counts.

If duplicate cells improve similarly versus historical parent, credit extra optimization coordinates rather than support specifically. Historical parent has1024 fewer weights and is not the capacity control.
Large opposite effects by encoding, null gate-replacement logit effect or benefit only in secondary Logloss weaken the primary support claim; single-seed changes remain preliminary.
Any leakage, nonfinite logits, wrong shape, boundary invariant failure or changed inherited features invalidates comparison and requires correction with costs retained.
alternative_explanations: The gate is computable from existing event populations and internal field-valid support/match counts; those supports are not all exposed to the parent classifier. When event fields are missing, exact recovery from existing classifier coordinates is not guaranteed. Gains may therefore reflect an informative explicit summary, easier inference of existing evidence, or both; they do not show new raw information or a causal preference.

Duplicate input changes effective Adam update geometry; matched allocated parameters do not equate effective feature rank, functional capacity or optimization. Raw-support and centered-support span the same function class but gradients differ.

Scale/sparsity differences, seed42 stochastic behavior, best-checkpoint selection and repeated validation-driven search can explain small gains; deterministic reruns at seed42 are not independent repetitions.

Past negatives remain: joint pair r0002-joint_pair0.6183522 below support_pair0.6184567; action_attention r0003~0.6179337 below its parent; adaptive query r0005~0.6185596 below blind0.6186035; active context r0006~0.6182829, aligned product r0007~0.6179084 and earlier target-centered r0008~0.6183568 also failed to beat their parents. Their mechanisms differ from this gate-plus-rank factorization; neither positive nor negative transfer is assumed.

In first512, 69.59% of supported coordinates had multiple match anchors and latest/all ranks had mean absolute gap0.13366 among support; this does not say every multiple-anchor coordinate changed. All-anchor replacement nevertheless worsened AUC by0.000120422 while improving Logloss. These diagnostics establish changed features, not a preference mechanism.

Static user/ad snapshots have undocumented as-of dates, histories capped128, category/brand lack item identity, and temporal validation is one study population. No production, causal, external-transfer or novelty assertion follows.
